content.short: Metric is an onchain exchange operating on Hyperliquid and Monad.
content.description: Metric runs exchange markets on both Hyperliquid and Monad, two chains built around high throughput for different reasons: one for its native order book, the other for parallel execution. Exchanges deploying to both are effectively testing whether faster block times translate into meaningfully better execution for ordinary swaps.
